documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, highlighting a significant revenue increase driven by strong volume growth and the commencement of operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility. Management noted healthy customer traction, a constructive outlook for organized jewellery, and ongoing expansion plans including a proposed rights issue and an upcoming Jaipur facility. While near-term EBITDA margins benefited from an unrealized inventory gain, sustainable margins are projected at 7.5% to 8%. The company remains optimistic about long-term demand and its growth trajectory in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company sticks to its top-line guidance of 50% to 60% growth in value terms and 30% to 40% growth in volume terms for the current year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margin for the year is projected to be around 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry outlook for organized jewellery remains constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and a preference for organized and branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on gold in the long term, citing strong long-term fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong. So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market, and we remain very bullish on that because the fundamentals remain very strong for the gold.

demand_outlook.claim: Organized retailers are increasingly focusing on inventory optimization, wider product offerings, and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, organized retailers are increasingly focusing on inventory optimization, wider product offerings, and faster design cycles, creating a structural opportunity for scalable and reliable jewellery manufacturers.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has allotted approximately INR47 crores for the Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations stood at INR716.38 crores with an EBITDA of INR71.45 crores and an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: Coming to our financial performance during quarter 1 FY27, the company reported revenue from operations of INR716.38 crores compared to the INR292.78 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 144.69%. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 2% to 2.5% of the reported EBITDA margin comprised unrealized gain locked in finished goods from the previous year due to a change in inventory valuation method.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR50.48 crores with a PAT margin of 7.05%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR50.48 crores, as compared to INR34.36 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 46.94% on a Y-o-Y basis. PAT margin for the quarter stood at 7.05 percentage.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization of the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-to-equity ratio is at 0.50.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds acquired from the rights issue will be invested completely in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to achieve a top-line growth of 50% to 60% in value terms and 30% to 40% in volume terms for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is expected to become operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.
